column1: # Batch 2b: double (70) - the site's "double meanings" category.
# Despite the category name, most of these are HOMOPHONE PUNS, not double
# meanings: Hull Yeah is "hell yeah" said wrong, not a phrase with two readings.
# The distinction matters for the radio gate - a homophone pun is exactly what
# gets misheard over VHF - so the mechanism is tagged by how the joke works,
# never by which category the site files it under.

column4: Cast Away / wash away my troubles
